mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diaries (user_id, title, content, mood, type, voice, voice_duration, video, video_thumb, diary_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{mood}, #{type}, #{voice}, #{voiceDuration}, #{video}, #{videoThumb}, #{diaryDate}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, content, mood, type, voice, voice_duration, video, video_thumb, diary_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM diaries WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE diaries SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, mood = #{mood}, type = #{type}, voice = #{voice}, voice_duration = #{voiceDuration}, video = #{video}, video_thumb = #{videoThumb}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, content, mood, type, voice, voice_duration, video, video_thumb, diary_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM diaries WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY diary_date DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diaries WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, user_id, title, content, mood, type, voice, voice_duration, video, video_thumb, diary_date, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM diaries WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND diary_date = #{date} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT d.id, d.user_id, d.title, d.content, d.mood, d.type, d.voice, d.voice_duration, d.video, d.video_thumb, d.diary_date, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.deleted FROM diaries d LEFT JOIN diary_tags dt ON d.id = dt.diary_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON dt.tag_id = t.id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND ( d.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY d.diary_date DESC, d.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) FROM diaries d LEFT JOIN diary_tags dt ON d.id = dt.diary_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON dt.tag_id = t.id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND ( d.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR d.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM diaries WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT type, COUNT(*) as count FROM diaries WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY type
SELECT t.name FROM tags t JOIN diary_tags dt ON t.id = dt.tag_id WHERE dt.diary_id = #{diaryId} ORDER BY t.name
